stages.explanation: Look only at the four yellow edge stickers on top. Use the cross builder to change a dot into an L, an L into a line, and a line into a cross. Ignore the corners for now.

stages.title: Put the yellow corners in their homes

stages.explanation: Keep yellow up and red front. Use top-front-right as the working slot. Twist that corner, then turn only U to bring in the next one. Do not stop while the lower layers look disturbed.
stages.checkpoint: Every face is a single color. The cube is solved.
